sloka: प्रजघ्ने च नृपो ऽरण्ये मृगाञ्छतसहस्रशः ।हत्वैव तृप्तिर्नाभूच्च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.८७.९ ॥
transliteration: prajaghne ca nṛpo 'raṇye mṛgāñchatasahasraśaḥ ।hatvaiva tṛptirnābhūcca rājñastasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.87.9 ॥

translations.english: And the king killed hundreds of thousands of animals in the forest, yet even after killing so many, that great-souled king was not satisfied.
